user.title: Add a photo frame
user.description: Enter the ID shown on the frame's screen. You can type it with or without the esp32p4- prefix, and with or without colons.

abort.already_configured: This frame has already been added.

error.invalid_frame_id: That does not look like a frame ID. It is shown on the frame's screen and looks like esp32p4-80f1b2d0b566.

display_photo.name: Show next photo
display_photo.description: Advance the frame to the next photo immediately.

device_id.name: Frame
device_id.description: Which frame to advance. Omit to advance every frame.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a control command to a frame.

command.name: Command
command.description: One of: next, previous, refresh, reload_ui, reboot.

device_id.name: Frame
